decision.explanation: The question asks for the formation year of the '64th Division'. The source documents describe two distinct entities with this name: the British '64th (2nd Highland) Division' (formed in 1914, per D1S2/D1S3) and the Imperial Japanese '64th Division' (formed on 1 May 1943, per D2S3/D3S3). Both are valid answers corresponding to distinct referents. The 64th Air Division (D4) and 6th Pursuit Wing (D6) are different entities and do not apply. The original R5 answers correctly identified both years.
